state: Our production checkout has been completely unavailable for 45 minutes. Every customer purchase is failing, we have no workaround, and revenue is being lost each minute.

urgency.instructions: Assess the urgency of this support case using the ordered impact levels.
criteria: Low: a cosmetic issue or general question with no interruption to business.
Moderate: a limited feature is impaired, but a reasonable workaround exists.
High: a major business function is impaired for some users with no practical workaround.
Critical: a production service is unavailable for all users and business activity is stopped.
